review.official:
Castle-3 is a custom
Raythean
-Plus six-wheeled operations platform built by
Closure
. A likeable mascot for
Rhodes Island
, his mundane disposition means he is largely ignored.
The solid blocky appearance of Castle-3 gives off a trustworthy, dependable impression.
The marks on his casing may represent kills, but who made the marks if he has no hands?

files.description:
[Top Speed] 23km/h 
[Climb] Normal 
[Brake] Normal 
[Mobility] Normal 
[Endurance] Excellent 
[Structural Integrity] Standard

He does not mind Closure's modifications, and is even quite pleased with the upgrade. His settings were changed to make Closure his favorite person, so he's satisfied with anything 'Master Closure' choses to do.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Thank you for choosing Castle-3! I am honored to serve as your assistant, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, please do not be intimidated by my appearance. My sturdy metal shell, modified by Master Closure herself, will make you invincible on the battlefield.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Warning: Do not strike this unit. It may cause hardware damage.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The topography in the wild may be treacherous, but Castle-3 is fitted with an engine with outstanding performance and a 4WD mode to whisk you away from danger.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, if your life is ever in danger, just summon Castle-3! Castle-3 was created specifically for combat purposes. I am a top-class defensive warfighting robot.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Castle-3 is honored to be at your side. Doctor, should you require me to strike down your foes, I shall go through heaven and hell to see it done!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Castle-3's official manager is 'Master Closure,' but please understand that you are even more important to Castle-3 than Master is, in most cases. I am your devoted, trustworthy battle companion!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Entering sleep mode. Press any button to wake.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Thank you for choosing Castle-3. Tap anywhere to initialize startup options.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart your reliable robot guard.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Device scan complete. All communications working as normal. Castle-3 is on standby, awaiting your orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Understood. Castle-3 is your best choice, Doctor, to lead a squad against enemy formations!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Now, Castle-3 will show you its true power as an industrial battle platform!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy unit located. Ready for attack.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Castle-3, awaiting orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Castle-3, ready and waiting.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Order received.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Acknowledged.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Show me what you've got!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Foul enemies, you are forbidden to advance.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Count up your sins!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Doctor, that was at last a worthy opponent!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor. Castle-3 is your best choice on the path of justice!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What an exciting battle! Let's fight together again next time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Is everyone all right? Castle-3 hopes its performance has exceeded your expectations.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I will hold up the rear. Everyone, retreat!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is there anything Castle-3 can help with?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Please be gentle when putting me down, Doctor!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to grab a drink together? I might not be able to actually have a drink, but I can still treat you to one. It is fine, Master Closure will pay.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New—Launching scheduled plugin. Switching to holiday mode—Whoohoo! New Year's Megarush Bonanza underway at Closure's Store! Some products up to a whole 10% off! Check out our new service: get an advance on your wages, at a monthly interest rate of only—Sorry Doctor, Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Lovely weather today, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Let me sing a birthday song for you. I have birthday songs from 31 different regions saved to memory. Which one should I play? Or should I loop a playlist? Or maybe you could use an exclusive discount on a birthday cake from Closure's Store!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I have a question. What exactly separates me and Rhodes Island as a landship? Is it functionality, or size? If I linked my smart module to Rhodes Island, then would I be 'me', or Rhodes Island?
